records.task: Locate the tracheal exterior behind the thyroid isthmus in the transverse CT view.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The superior end and inferior display cut agree with the same-subject label. After localized shoulder correction the worst protected thyroid cut is 2.19 mm.
scoreEvidence.form: The two crops show a gently curved shaft with a smooth broad highlight. The flat inferior profiles mark display cuts. The detailed master retains the source-defined distal split.
scoreEvidence.readability: At the transverse entry the dark air column lies immediately behind the thyroid isthmus. Its position is visible in grayscale and confirmed by the axial orbit and labeled overlay.
scoreEvidence.economy: The thyroid port uses 2,900 triangles. Across 24 views the largest turning-silhouette departure from the dense port is 0.50 px.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D orientation task
records.note: Landmark orientation from the traced air-column exterior. The model supplies no airway wall thickness, patency or clinical airway measurement.

comparison.label: Previous and selected tracheal display crops
comparison.candidateLabel: The two inferior cut levels reproduce the fields used by the thyroid and carotid sweeps.

views.label: Full tracheal label and two derived crop exteriors
views.candidateLabel: Only the full field contains the distal bifurcation.

views.label: Raw-label cuts at the airway and the two crop caps
views.candidateLabel: The localized shoulder correction preserves small grazing contours and the measured position behind the isthmus.

views.label: Tracheal landmark at thyroid frames 0 and 12
views.candidateLabel: At the transverse entry, the dark air column sits behind the isthmus. The unchanged scan and overlay locate it.

records.task: Use the short tracheal air-column exterior to orient the medial side of the 3D carotid scene.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The two crop rims and the native end pass the raw checks. The frozen carotid planes are empty on both the label and mesh.
scoreEvidence.form: The short cut keeps the case-specific curvature and superior taper, with the inferior face explicitly cropped.
scoreEvidence.readability: The axial orbit puts the pale tracheal landmark medial to the selected artery. It stays outside the saved carotid image planes.
scoreEvidence.economy: The context crop uses 2,000 triangles and 36,032 bytes. Its 24-view silhouette differs by at most 0.50 px.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D context use
records.note: Both carotid sweeps show the trachea as 3D context. Their frame-12 and frame-48 scan planes do not intersect its label.
